slides.title: Purpose of this discussion
bullets: Agree where a candidate set leaves computational work and enters exposure testing
Agree which data travels with each hand-off, and in what format
Agree who owns the analysis steps that make a result reproducible
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
slides.notes: Keep this to the hand-off. Modelling choices are a separate conversation.

slides.title: The biological question comes first
bullets: Each engagement starts from the target question and the decision it has to support
The candidate set is defined by that question, not by what the library happens to contain

bullets.text: Selection criteria written down before any scoring is run

bullets: Data provenance recorded for every input: source library, version and date
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Stage 1: triage and docking
slides.subtitle: Virtual library triage, docking and hit clustering
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Triage and docking
bullets: Virtual library triage removes compounds failing the agreed property filters
Docking scores reported in kcal/mol against a fixed receptor model
bullets_right: Hit clustering groups the remaining compounds by scaffold
Cluster representatives chosen by the medicinal chemistry team, not by score alone
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Model uncertainty
bullets: Docking poses are hypotheses about binding, not measurements
Compare scores only under consistent model and scoring settings; even within a scaffold cluster, ranking is tentative until checked against experimental evidence
Where two receptor models disagree on a pose, both are carried forward and flagged
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Reproducibility steps
bullets: Analysis notebook pinned to the software versions used for the scoring run
Random seeds recorded where a docking or clustering step uses them
Any manual edit to the candidate set logged with a reason and a name
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
slides.notes: Nadia's checklist is the one to use. Keep the list short so people actually fill it in.

slides.title: What Quenverell needs back
bullets: Measured exposure and clearance for tested compounds, with matrix, species, route and assay normalisation stated as applicable
Notes on any compound that could not be tested, and why
Data returned in the same identifiers as the candidate set list
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Feeding results back into the model
bullets: Results are added as a new data drop, not overwritten into the old one
Model gate reviewed before any re-scoring is run

bullets.text: Changes to the scoring weights recorded in the notebook history
